description: Set up cross-region PostgreSQL logical replication from us-east-1 (primary) to eu-west-1 (standby) for disaster recovery. The primary handles ~20,000 TPS across 400 databases. Replication must be filtered to a subset of critical databases (12 out of 400). Maximum acceptable lag: 5 seconds under normal conditions, 30 seconds under peak. Must implement automated failback procedure when the primary region recovers. Risk factors: logical replication slot retention causing WAL bloat on primary, schema changes on primary breaking replication, network latency spikes between regions, conflict resolution for bidirectional use cases, and failback without data loss. Full DR drill must be automated and verified quarterly. Tools available: pglogical, pglogical_output, Terraform, AWS DMS, Route53 DNS failover, Chaos Mesh for fault injection.
